source.original_question:
A driver glances up at the top of a building.

True or false: According to the angle A, the distance from the driver to the building would be the opposite side.
Choice:
A. True
B. False

adaptations.reason: Decorative scenery/icons removed; native mathematical lines, angle arcs, measurements and point relationships retained.

independent_solution.method: Relative to the angle at the driverA, the ground distanceAB touches that angle and is the adjacent leg. The opposite leg is the buildingheightBC. ThereforeFalse, optionB.
